newsitem.title: ITALY: Rinascente group 1996 sales up seven pct.
newsitem.headline: Rinascente group 1996 sales up seven pct.

text.p: Italian retail chain Rinascente said sales in 1996 rose seven percent on 1995 to 7.17 trillion lire in a market which saw relatively flat consumer demand.
The company, part of the Fiat group, said in a statement that the food sector performed well, with its Citta Mercato and SMA supermarkets accounting for 75.7 percent of total sales.
Its Upim and Grandi Magazzini chain stores saw lower total sales, affected most by falling demand for consumer goods.
Rinascente, which made a consolidated net profit of 85.8 billion lire in 1995, posted a first half 1996 group pretax loss of 500 million lire.
